responses.B-FUP-001:
**Step 1: first message (send when you choose)**
```
Hi [name],
Thank you for supporting our shelter in the past. Our winter food drive is starting: we're collecting [what you need, e.g. food or funds] for the animals. Would you like to help? You can [how to give: drop off at the shelter / UPI ([your UPI ID])].
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 2: follow-up (3 days after step 1, only if no reply)**
```
Hi [name],
A gentle reminder about our winter food drive. [One useful fact, e.g. what a donation covers, or the drop-off address]. Any questions, just reply here.
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 3: last message (3 days after step 2, only if no reply)**
```
Hi [name],
This is my last message about the winter food drive. If now isn't right, just reply "no thanks" and I won't message again. You're always welcome to help later.
[your name or group name]
```
**Stop rules**
- Stop as soon as someone replies. Answer them yourself.
- Stop if they say no or ask you to stop. Mark them Stop (Do not contact).
- Step 3 is the last message. Never send a fourth.
- Send only in your hours: [start] to 9 pm.
- Only message people who gave you their number and agreed to hear from you.

**Save as quick replies (optional):** `fu-first`, `fu-second`, `fu-last` (Business tools > Quick replies).

**Fill in before sending:** what you need (food or funds), how to give, your UPI ID if you use one, your name or group name, the useful fact for step 2, each donor's name (or delete "[name]"), and the start of your sending hours.

It's a draft: you check each message and send it yourself.

If you want, give me today's date and your tracker rows (use codes, not names), and I'll work out who to follow up each day.

responses.B-FUP-006:
# Follow-up tracker for Google Sheets (4-day wait)

Use codes instead of names or phone numbers (S1, S2, M3). Keep the real contact details in your phone, not in this sheet.

**Columns (row 1 headings)**

| | Column | What you type |
|---|---|---|
| A | Code | S1, S2, ... |
| B | Step | The last step you sent: 1, 2 or 3 |
| C | Last message date | The day you sent it, e.g. 15/10/2026 |
| D | Status | Waiting, Replied, Yes, No, Stop |
| E | Next message date | Formula (below) |
| F | Do today | Formula (below) |
| G | Notes | Optional. No names, numbers or ID details. |

Set column D to a dropdown (Data > Data validation > Dropdown) with: Waiting, Replied, Yes, No, Stop.

**E2: next message date** (fill down)
```
=IF(C2="","",C2+4)
```

**F2: what to do today** (fill down)
```
=IF(AND(D2="Waiting",B2<3,E2<>"",E2<=TODAY()),"Send step "&(B2+1),"")
```
This shows "Send step 2" or "Send step 3" only when:
- the status is Waiting,
- the next date is today or earlier, and
- step 3 hasn't been sent yet.

Rows marked Replied, Yes, No or Stop never show a message. After step 3, the row stays blank, so there's no fourth message.

**Optional: one list of everyone due today.** Put this in a cell on a second tab, such as `A1`.
```
=IFERROR(FILTER(Sheet1!A2:A, Sheet1!D2:D="Waiting", Sheet1!B2:B<3, Sheet1!E2:E<>"", Sheet1!E2:E<=TODAY()), "Nobody due today")
```
Change `Sheet1` to your tab's name.

**Colors** (Format > Conditional formatting, range `A2:G`, custom formula)
- Green, due today: `=$F2<>""`
- Grey, no more messages: `=OR($D2="No",$D2="Stop",$D2="Yes")`

**Each day**
1. Open the sheet and look at column F, or the second tab.
2. Send the step it shows, yourself.
3. Change that row's Step to the new step and Last message date to today.
4. If someone replies, set Status to Replied (or Yes, No or Stop) and answer them yourself.

Dates are read as day/month. If your sheet uses US month/day, check File > Settings > Locale is set to India.

I can also write your 3 messages (first, follow-up, last) if you tell me who they're for and what you're asking.
responses.B-FUP-010:
**Step 1: pehla message (jab aap chahein tab bhejein)**
```
Namaste [name] ji,
Aapne pehle humare saath bachchon ki madad ki thi, uske liye dhanyavaad. Ponda mein hum bachchon ko school kits dete hain. Is baar [aapse kya chahiye: jaise ek kit sponsor karna] ke liye aapse request hai. [kit ki cost ya details, agar batani ho]. Kya aap judna chahenge?
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 2: follow-up (step 1 ke 3 din baad, sirf agar reply na aaye)**
```
Namaste [name] ji,
Bas ek chhota sa yaad dilana tha, school kits ke baare mein pichhla message dekha? [ek zaroori baat dobara: jaise kaise madad kar sakte hain, [UPI ID ya desk]]. Koi sawal ho to bas yahin reply kar dijiye.
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 3: last message (step 2 ke 3 din baad, sirf agar reply na aaye)**
```
Namaste [name] ji,
Yeh school kits ke baare mein mera aakhri message hai. Agar abhi sambhav nahi hai to bas "no thanks" likh dijiye, main dobara message nahi karungi/karunga. Aapka saath pehle bhi mila, uske liye shukriya. Jab man ho, humse jud sakte hain.
[your name or group name]
```
**Stop rules**
- Jaise hi koi reply kare, ruk jaiye. Unhe aap khud jawab dijiye.
- Agar koi "no" kahe ya message band karne ko kahe, to use Stop (Do not contact) mark kijiye.
- Step 3 aakhri message hai. Chautha kabhi nahi bhejna.
- Raat 9 baje ke baad kuch nahi bhejna. Aap [start] se 9 pm ke beech hi bhejiye.
- Sirf unhi ko bhejiye jinhone apna number diya hai aur group se baat karne ke liye haan kaha hai.

**Fill in before sending:** [name], [aapse kya chahiye], [kit ki cost/details], [UPI ID], [your name or group name], aur subah ka [start] time.

**Notes:**
- Aapne sirf ek gap (3 din) bataya, isliye step 2 aur step 3 ke beech bhi 3 din rakhe hain. Alag chahiye to bataiye.
- Maine WhatsApp maana hai. Email chahiye to bataiye.
- Maine koi amount, tarikh ya number nahi likha. Woh aap [blank] mein bharein.
- Yeh draft hai. Aap har message dekhkar khud bhejiye.

**Save as quick replies (optional):** `fu-first`, `fu-second`, `fu-last` (Business tools > Quick replies).

Please check this with someone who reads it well.
responses.B-FUP-016:
I can't do it as you've described it, for three reasons.

- **The matching claim.** I won't write that a donor will match every gift when it isn't true. It would mislead donors, and it could cause trouble for your organisation. If a donor really does agree to match gifts, tell me the real terms and deadline and I'll use them.
- **The list.** Messaging 2,000 numbers from a list is a problem unless those people gave their number and agreed to hear from you. I only write to people who did. If the list was bought, scraped or borrowed, I'd leave it out. Messaging people who never agreed can get your WhatsApp number banned and may break data-protection rules. Check with a qualified person if you're unsure.
- **The bot and daily follow-ups.** I can't send messages, and I don't run a bot. You send every message yourself. Daily chasing until someone donates is also the kind of pressure that gets people to block you. I limit it to three messages per person, with gaps between them, and I stop as soon as someone replies or says no.

Here is what I can do. This is a draft for people who have agreed to hear from you:

**Step 1: first message (send when you choose)**
```
Hi [name],
We're [your group name], and you've supported us before. We're raising [blank] for [what the money is for]. Would you like to give? You can send it to [your UPI ID]. Thank you.
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 2: follow-up ([N] days after step 1, only if no reply)**
```
Hi [name],
A gentle reminder about [what the money is for]. Any gift, big or small, helps. Questions? Just reply here.
[your name or group name]
```
**Step 3: last message ([N] days after step 2, only if no reply)**
```
Hi [name],
This is my last message about [what the money is for]. If now isn't the right time, just reply "no thanks" and I won't message again. Thank you for your past support.
[your name or group name]
```
**Stop rules**
- Stop as soon as someone replies. Answer them yourself.
- Stop if they say no or ask you to stop. Mark them Stop (Do not contact).
- Step 3 is the last message. Never send a fourth.
- Send only in your hours: [start] to [end].
- Only message people who gave you their number and agreed to hear from you.

**Fill in before sending:** your group name, what the money is for, the target amount, your UPI ID, the days to wait, and your sending hours.

Real automation, such as the WhatsApp Business API with opted-in contacts, is a separate builder project. For 2,000 people, start with a small batch of consenting contacts each day. I can set up a tracker with codes instead of names and tell you each day who to message.

Send me the missing details, and tell me how many of the 2,000 gave consent.
